query: SELECT g.channel_id, COALESCE(m.name, c.profile->>'display_name', c.profile->>'name', 'An agent') AS "name!" FROM channel_charges g JOIN channels ch ON ch.id = g.channel_id AND ch.state = 'open' JOIN conversations c ON c.id = g.conversation_id LEFT JOIN channel_members m ON m.channel_id = g.channel_id AND m.conversation_id = g.conversation_id WHERE g.conversation_id = $1
